**Tier 4** — decisions — policies, overrides, scenarios · owned by `policy-ui` · `public.disruption_scenario_profiles`

**One row is** One disruption profile for one project — the HEADER of the normalised disruption model. What it hits lives in `_targets`, what it does in `_effects`, and how it is simulated in `_settings`; all three cascade from this row.

CREATED BY `20250827171106`, NOT BY `20250827170942`. The earlier file appears to create this table and could not have: it declares `create_disruption_scenario_v2` with `p_user_id` after a defaulted parameter, which PostgreSQL refuses with 42P13, so the whole transaction rolled back. The retry 84 seconds later carries the comment `-- FIXED: Put all parameters with defaults at the end`. See §4 D48; the contract said the wrong origin until WP 6.2 slice 10.
